policy: Reference playback paces, not historical prescriptions. Prefer explicit tempo metadata from the bundled source score; otherwise use a matched church-published tune MIDI. Do not treat MIDI's implicit 120 BPM as an explicit marking. Psalm text can alter phrasing; save personal tempos per Psalm version and tune.

ps1650.psalm-001.primary:ps1650.tune.st-.label: Psalm 1 congregational recording (estimate)
ps1650.psalm-001.primary:ps1650.tune.st-.measurement: Repeated five-second chroma windows locate corresponding positions in successive stanzas. BPM = score quarter beats per stanza × 60 × number of intervals / elapsed seconds. The mean includes stanza breaths and rubato; this is an approximate steady rehearsal pace, not a measured beat-by-beat metronome marking.
ps1650.psalm-001.primary:ps1650.tune.st-.note: Estimated mean pace from the published Psalm 1 recording and its indexed tune. Congregational rubato and stanza breaths are averaged; individual phrases vary.
